summary: The customer called because of an unexpected fifty dirham charge on their bill for international roaming, which they disputed since they had not traveled. The agent checked the system, explained that the charge was for data usage on Tuesday, and after the customer protested, raised a technical ticket for investigation with a 48-hour timeframe and a potential refund if confirmed as a system error.

commitments.description: Raise a technical ticket that will take 48 hours to investigate.

evidence.text: راح نعملها waiver ونسوي لها refund.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Waive and refund the charge if it is found to be a system error.
